Container.Name: print-buddy-nightly
Container.Overview:
Print Buddy NIGHTLY is the development build of Print Buddy in the same ONE container as the stable template: the Discord bot, the Moonraker listener, OrcaSlicer (stable 2.4.2 or alpha 2.5.0-alpha, chosen with PRINT_BUDDY_ORCA_CHANNEL) and the bundled Spoolman API under one supervisor. Print Buddy is the interface; Spoolman's web UI is not included. The Spoolman API listens on 127.0.0.1:8000 inside the container and no port is published. Printers are external services.
WHAT NIGHTLY MEANS: the image is rebuilt every night from the newest commit on Print Buddy's main branch that passed the full CI suite, and this template's :nightly tag moves to that build. It passes the same offline container acceptance as a release, but features may be unfinished and settings may change without a release note. There is no fixed digest to verify because the tag floats by design. Prefer the stable print-buddy template for a printer you rely on; run nightly to try current code or to confirm a fix before it ships.
This template is separate from the stable one on purpose: it installs as its own container with its own appdata paths under /mnt/user/appdata/print-buddy-nightly, so both can sit side by side. Leave the Discord token empty to stage and validate first: the listener and Spoolman run while the bot stays idle. Never give the nightly and stable bots the same Discord token at the same time.
Container.ExtraParams: --user 1000:1000 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit 256 --memory 2g --cpus 2 --shm-size 256m --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3 --restart unless-stopped --health-cmd "python3 /usr/local/bin/print-buddy-healthcheck" --health-interval 30s --health-timeout 10s --health-start-period 90s --health-retries 3
Container.Requires: Appdata paths owned by UID/GID 1000. Existing Spoolman data can be copied into the Spoolman Data path before first start; nothing is migrated automatically.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Runtime state, prompts, hardware and job records. Back this up.

Config.Name: Archive
Config.Description: Sliced jobs and G-code. Back this up.

Config.Name: Spoolman data
Config.Description: Bundled Spoolman database, config, logs and backups. Back this up.

Config.Name: Settings file
Config.Description: Leave as is, or point at a mounted YAML file for list settings.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Secret. Leave empty to stage the listener and Spoolman without the Discord bot.

Config.Name: Allowed user IDs
Config.Description: Discord user IDs allowed to use the bot, comma or space separated.

Config.Name: Moonraker URL
Config.Description: Klipper printers, for example http://printer.example:7125. Fluidd is not needed here.

Config.Name: Spoolman URL
Config.Description: Bundled Spoolman API by default. To use an existing external Spoolman, set its URL here and set Bundled Spoolman to false; nothing is migrated.

Config.Name: Bundled Spoolman
Config.Description: true runs the bundled Spoolman API; false uses the external Spoolman URL.

Config.Name: OrcaSlicer channel
Config.Description: Bundled OrcaSlicer channel selected at startup: stable (default) or alpha. Any other value stops the container at startup.

Config.Name: Container timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, an IANA name such as UTC. Print Buddy schedules use the discord.timezone setting; TZ covers container logs, the OS clock and the bundled Spoolman.
